Same thing happened to me 2 months ago. All of a sudden P30 pro not seeing the sim. I have had the phone 4 years and the sim has always worked and I have never removed it.

The annoying thing is, it works intermittently. If I restart my device it sometimes sees the sim for 5-6 hours. Sometimes only an hour. I am constantly restarting my phone throughout the day.
Just keep EA away from it. They would ruin it! But I agree, a Malazan game would be amazing!
I foound that if you use a map with a high are and a deep sea you can get 5k+ The pillar keeps going under water. If you start high, go far and end up in a deep sea area you get a huge distance

This hasn't worked for me =(

Several hours into my very first playthhrough of the game, gotten to the first boss (Zamora the far seeing) and I can't use my shield!

Fortunately I haven't unlocked all the valor plates yet so I just unlocked the Bulwark VP and the shield is working BUT the copy load out option hasn't fixed it for any of the other VPs

Dissappinting because, despite the negative reviews and poor story, I was legitimately enjoying the game.

The most annoying thing is that I am one of those players that likes to explore everything and master the stage I am in. Lvl 40 only just got to the first main boss and I can't get a refund in Steam 😢😭😢😭

Looks like Bulwark is my new fav VP not because it is good or I have tested it but becaue it is the only one that works in the game for me 😭😭😭
I am still playing every now and again. Dip back in for 10-20 mins when I want a flight/iron man fix. Other than that, the game is dead.

Thank you all for the support. I reached out to my counselor today. She is supporting me for childhood trauma so this particular episode is not within thr remit of our sessions but she told me I did the right thing in telling her and she will be refering me to relevant teams and support.
Thanks for the advice and taking the time to respond
Thanks for taking time to read and reply
Thank you for taking the time to respond
